items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: He came to the house and he told Dizzy and Elaine, 'Mary is a saint.' ... He began coming around to try to get me out to play.

ctx.x: Was this the period when you just went to the church every day and prayed?
Yes, I prayed. I prayed for everybody but myself until Father Crowley says, 'Listen, you better pray for yourself too while you're praying for everybody.'
